note: Asset pack registry for the medieval sandbox. Sizes are approximate download sizes. Nothing here is committed to git: packs/ is ignored apart from this registry, so the repository stays small.

budget.notes: The engine boots with zero binary assets (procedural atlas). Packs are opt-in and loaded per scene.

packs.name: Poly Haven — Sky HDRI (1k)
packs.why: Skybox and image-based ambient light for the day/night cycle

packs.name: Kenney — Castle Kit
packs.why: Upgrades the box keeps and towers to authored walls, gates and battlements

packs.name: Kenney — Nature Kit
packs.why: Replaces the procedural pine and boulder boxes

packs.name: Kenney — Medieval RTS
packs.why: World-map markers, banners and the strategy map layer

packs.name: Kenney — UI Pack
packs.why: Touch-first HUD and menus for the Android build

packs.name: Kenney — RPG Audio
packs.why: Sword, hit, gather and UI sounds

packs.name: Quaternius — Ultimate Fantasy Pack
packs.why: Animated knights, villagers and fantasy creatures
